thread:
June: hey team — quick question from my first day: ran into a VPN + yubikey hiccup while setting up my laptop. where's the best place to post this so IT can help and others can find the solution later? also what deploy/infra bots should i subscribe to? any polite-hours rules for pings (@here/@channel)?

Olivia: welcome June! :tada: For setup stuff (VPN, badge, keys) post in #help and tag it-help. If it's specifically infra creds or CI access ping me or Sam in #eng-infra. For things you want discoverable, put the summary in the thread and paste any commands/logs.

it-help: hi June — please open a ticket first so we can track it. you can use the shortcut: `Create IT ticket` in the Slack app or email it@redwood.com. if you paste the last 3 lines of the VPN log we can triage faster.

June: thanks — here are last lines: ```Apr 6 09:12:21 vpn-client[1234]: CHK_YUBI: timed out
Apr 6 09:12:22 vpn-client[1234]: auth failed (yubikey)
Apr 6 09:12:22 NetworkManager: restarting vpn connection```

Sam (eng-infra): for infra notifications we use two things: deploy alerts in #eng-releases and paging/incidents via #eng-oncall (and PagerDuty). If you want deploy noise in your DMs, subscribe to the deploy-bot in the channel where it posts:
```/subscribe deploy-bot #eng-releases```
and for perf/infra alerts:
```/subscribe infra-alerts #eng-oncall```
If you're just exploring, I'd recommend not subscribing to #eng-oncall (those are noisy at night) — only subscribe if you're on-call.

June: good to know. how strict are we about @here/@channel? i don't want to wake anyone up in europe.

Olivia: rule of thumb — avoid @channel/@here outside local business hours unless it's urgent and you expect people to wake up (outages, major deploy rollbacks). use a thread or DM individuals for help. use reactions like :eyes: or :thumbsup: for quick ack.

Matt (oncall): adding — if it's an incident that requires immediate attention, call the oncall phone and then post a short summary in #incidents. otherwise please use threads. Reposting the same issue across channels is the fastest way to create confusion.

deploy-bot: Subscribed user June to #eng-releases (ephemeral). Use `unsubscribe deploy-bot` to opt out.

onboard-bot: Welcome June! Check the pinned doc in #new-hires: https://wiki.redwood.com/onboarding/slack-norms and the 'First 48 hours' checklist.

June: perfect, thanks everyone. i'll open the IT ticket and post the troubleshooting summary in #help, then follow up in #eng-infra if needed. also leaving #eng-oncall unsubscribed for now. :slightly_smiling_face:
